properties.description: BL-141(a). Every circular_dependency finding now states its basis: the Interfaces any hop was collapsed out of, whether ANY hop is backed by a real DEPENDS_ON edge, and whether every Interface involved is a library/data medium — something read or linked against rather than called across at run time. dependency_pairs collapses `c CONSUMES i` + `p PROVIDES i` into a direct pair, which is correct for detection and discards the one datum a reader needs to tell a coarse interface model from a tangled call graph; the medium is now kept beside the pair instead of thrown away. A REPORT, never a verdict (dec:report-dont-judge): reflow2 cannot know whether one Interface node is standing for two contracts, so it names what it walked and leaves the judgement to the reader — the BL-114 fix shape applied to this detector. Detection semantics are UNCHANGED: the same cycles are found, with the same severity. Whether a foundation-medium contract loop should count as a dependency cycle at all is BL-141(b), still open.
properties.name: A dependency cycle says which edge kinds it walked, and through which contracts
